title: India’s Sun Pharma Plots $12 Billion Organon Buyout For Global Reach

title: China Blocks Meta’s $2 Billion Acquisition of AI Firm Manus
title_zh: 中国阻止 Meta 以 20 亿美元收购人工智能公司 Manus
summary: (Bloomberg) -- China has decided to block Meta Platforms Inc.’s $2 billion acquisition of agentic AI startup Manus, a surprise move to unwind a controversial deal that’s drawn fire for the leakage of technology to the US.Most Read from BloombergThe Billion-Barrel Hormuz Oil Sh...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——中国决定阻止 Meta Platforms Inc. 以 20 亿美元收购代理人工智能初创公司 Manus，此举出人意料，旨在解除一项因向美国泄露技术而引发争议的争议交易。

title: Wall Street banks offered Anthropic access on sharply different fees
title_zh: 华尔街银行以截然不同的费用提供 Anthropic 访问权限
summary: Morgan Stanley charged a flat 1% transaction fee, while Goldman Sachs proposed a costlier structure involving ongoing management fees and a profit share.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利收取 1% 的固定交易费，而高盛提出了一种成本更高的结构，涉及持续管理费和利润分成。

title: Forvia Sells Auto Interiors Business to Apollo Funds in $2.1 Billion Deal
title_zh: Forvia 以 21 亿美元的价格将汽车内饰业务出售给 Apollo Funds
summary: The French auto parts supplier said the deal allows it to sharpen focus on high value-added, technology-driven activities, while shoring up its balance sheet.
summary_zh: 这家法国汽车零部件供应商表示，此次交易使其能够更加关注高附加值、技术驱动的活动，同时支撑其资产负债表。

title: Morningstar Says Software Stocks Haven't Been This Undervalued In 3 Years. These 3 Look Like Good Deals.
title_zh: 晨星公司表示，软件股票三年来从未被低估过。这 3 个看起来很划算。
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) disruption is a real threat, but investors are panicking about its impact on these companies.
summary_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 颠覆是一个真正的威胁，但投资者对其对这些公司的影响感到恐慌。
